title: Faulad No.1
desc: Our story revolves around Jackie who worshipped the body of his beloved like a temple and in order to gain access into this abode of heaven, he bargained his future by marrying a rich spoilt damsel, to gain access to her ill-gotten wealth and shower them at the feet of his beloved, but his rich wife Mona soon found out and decided to teach him a lesson

title: Kuch Toh Hai
desc: The movie follows the story of a young couple who move into a new house, only to discover that it is haunted by a mysterious presence. As they try to unravel the truth behind the entity, they uncover a dark secret that threatens their very existence.

title: Lucky-No Time For Love
desc: A story of Lucky, a yound girl who is taken in by a wealthy family in Russia after being orphaned in war-torn Afghanistan . While adapting to her new surroundings, she meets a man who is initially distant and unapproachable, but eventually spend more time together and form a deep bond. Despite facing cultural differences and other obstacles, their love perseveres as they strive to be together.

title: Astitva
desc: The movie follows the story of Aditi, a devoted wife, who discovers her husband's infidelity. As she confronts her husband and delves deeper into the truth, she begins to question her own identity and place in society.

title: Joshila Janbaz
desc: Bhagvathi, a tea vendor, has big dreams for his younger brother, Guna. However, Guna gets killed by his girlfriend's father, who is unaware that his daughter is pregnant.
